name: Dell student discount
summary: Up to 15% off selected Dell laptops and desktops for students in Australia.
key: 15% off selected Dell and XPS laptops, 10% off selected Dell Pro laptops and desktops.
who: Current or newly accepted full-time or part-time students at accredited Australian institutions.
need: Proof of enrolment, such as a student ID, timetable or fee receipt.
how: Verify through SheerID on Dell's student page. It's usually instant.
The discount comes off automatically at checkout on Dell.com.
catches: Up to 2 discounted items per order and 4 items a year.
Can't be combined with other coupons, and excludes clearance and limited-quantity deals.
The current offer ends on 30 October 2026.
